# NovaPanel v1.6.140

- Editing a Mieru inbound into another protocol now stops the independent Mita listener before the replacement binds, avoiding same-port TCP conflicts.
- New Shadowsocks inbounds default to an encrypted method. Invalid multi-user `method=none` configurations now fail validation before saving instead of rolling back after runtime startup fails.
- Added same-port protocol-conversion and Shadowsocks validation regression tests.
